caption: The page Block Countries of the app Securify in the Shopify admin of our development store, scrolled to the world map: Brazil is red (User Blocked), the United States, China, Japan, Sweden, Germany, France and Pakistan are yellow (Risk Flagged), the rest is grey (Neutral). Below the map is the table Current Restrictions (1) with one row, Brazil, code BR, and the buttons Remove and Delete All. The left menu shows Block Countries, Block IPs, Block Emails and Order Protection.

The dialog Choose Your Plan of the app Securify (Cancel anytime), monthly view: Free $0 / mo (marked Current; Review 5 risky orders a month, An alert for every risky order, Block unlimited countries & IPs, 500 blocked visitors a month, Content protection, Last 1,000 visitor logs and 7 days of analytics), Pro $19.00 / mo (button Start free trial, 7-day free trial, Review 25 risky orders a month, Unlimited blocked visitors, VPN, proxy & datacenter blocking, Good-bot management, Email check on every new order, Custom block page) and Growth $49.00 / mo (button Start free trial, 7-day free trial, Unlimited risky orders, Smart bot blocking, Customer risk scan for your whole list).

The same dialog Choose Your Plan in the yearly view (Yearly, save up to 30%), scrolled down: Free $0 / mo, Pro $159.00 / yr and Growth $490.00 / yr, with the full feature lists (Pro: Visitor export of the last 2,000 logs, 30 days of analytics; Growth: Block buyers by email at checkout too, Auto-tag risky customers, Unlimited visitor logs) and a note that a risky order counts once, the first time you open its details, hold it, cancel it or mark it not risky.

The first pop-up of the app, Turn on the Securify app embed, which says that Securify runs on the storefront through a theme app embed and that until it is turned on visitors are not checked, country and VPN rules are not enforced and the store is not protected. It shows an example picture of the theme editor with App embeds, and the buttons Not now and Open theme editor. The name in the header of the example picture (a demo store name that belongs to the app's own picture) and the store name at the bottom of the left menu are covered.
